topic_title: Traffic Laws as the Foundation for Decisions
prompt: Under the Texas Safety Responsibility Act, what are the mandatory minimum liability insurance limits (30/60/25) required to operate a motor vehicle?

options.text: $30,000 injury per person, $60,000 total crash, and $25,000 property damage
$25,000 injury per person, $50,000 total crash, and $20,000 property damage
$50,000 injury per person, $100,000 total crash, and $30,000 property damage
$20,000 injury per person, $40,000 total crash, and $15,000 property damage
